title: My Quiet Bible · Heluhelu, pule, kaʻana, hana hou
description: Heluhelu, pule, kaʻana, hana hou. Ka Baibala ma nā unuhina he {{versions}} a ma nā ʻōlelo he {{languages}}, he pihi 🙏 e pule leo nui ai no ka mea āu i heluhelu ai, a me nā pōʻai pilikino liʻiliʻi e kaʻana ai i kāu mau pule. Manuahi, ʻaʻohe hoʻolaha, hana me ka pili ʻole i ka pūnaewele.
sub: Ka Baibala wale nō: ʻaʻohe papa heluhelu, ʻaʻohe nūhou, ʻaʻohe hoʻolaha. Manuahi, a hana ia me ka pili ʻole i ka pūnaewele.
homeScreen: E kau ma kou Home Screen
installAndroid: E kau ma kou kelepona Android
hint: ʻAʻohe kākau inoa. Wehe ʻia ma ʻaneʻi nō, i loko o kou polokalamu kele pūnaewele.
verseSub:
Nā unuhina he {{versions}} ma nā ʻōlelo he {{languages}}, he waiwai lehulehu a he laikini hāmama paha kēlā me kēia.
          Ka paukū hoʻokahi, ma kekahi o lākou:
inH: A me nā mea ʻē aʻe a pau
biblesP: Nā unuhina he {{versions}} ma nā ʻōlelo he {{languages}}: ka King James, Louis Segond 1910, Luther, Reina-Valera, ka Baibala Hebera a me ke Kauoha Hou Helene, ka canon ʻAitiopa ma ka ʻōlelo Pelekānia, Palani a me Geʻeza, a he nui hou aku. E hoʻohālike a hiki i ʻeono ma ka ʻaoʻao kekahi i kekahi.
searchH: He ʻimi e loaʻa ai nā mea
searchP: He huaʻōlelo, he māmalaʻōlelo, ʻelua huaʻōlelo e pili kokoke ana, ma hoʻokahi Baibala a ma nā Baibala he nui paha, me nā hua i helu ʻia ma ka puke. E kikokiko i kahi kuhikuhi a aia ʻoe ma laila. Nā helu Strong's pū kekahi.
offlineP: Noho nā Baibala āu e heluhelu ai ma kou kelepona. Ma ka mokulele, ma uka, i loko o ka lumi lalo: wehe ʻia ma ka paukū āu i haʻalele ai, me ka pili ʻole i ka pūnaewele.
marksH: Nā kaha kala, nā manaʻo kākau a me nā kaha ʻaoʻao
marksP: ʻEwalu kala, he manaʻo kākau ma kekahi paukū a ma kekahi māhele holoʻokoʻa paha, he lipine no nā wahi āu e hoʻi pinepine ai. E lawe mai i nā mea āu i mālama ai ma kekahi polokalamu Baibala ʻē aʻe. Kaha i kekahi paukū me he peni hoʻomālamalama lā, a i ʻole e hoʻokala i kona mau hua.
devicesP: Inā makemake ʻoe wale nō. E komo me kahi kī komo a me kahi helu i hoʻouna ʻia ma ka leka uila paha, a e hahai nā kaha kala, nā manaʻo kākau a me nā hoʻonohonoho iā ʻoe. Komo ka mīkini ʻelua mai ka mīkini mua me hoʻokahi loulou; ʻaʻohe mea e kikokiko ai.
verseShareP: E hoʻouna i kahi paukū i WhatsApp, Facebook a i ʻole X me hoʻokahi pā, ma ke ʻano he kiʻi mālie i hana ʻia ma kāu mea ponoʻī.
readingP: ʻEono ʻano hua kikokiko, hoʻokahi o lākou no ka ʻike maka nāwaliwali. Nā hua nui e like me kou makemake, a me nā pihi maʻalahi ke ʻike. E pākuʻi e huli i ka mokuna. Māmā, Sepia a Pōuli paha, e like me kēia ʻaoʻao.
nots:
• ʻAʻohe papa heluhelu. ʻAʻohe haʻawina hoʻomana i kākau ʻia. ʻAʻohe mea a mākou i koho ai nou.
  • ʻAʻohe hoʻolaha. ʻAʻohe hahai. ʻAʻohe kuki.
  • ʻAʻohe uku komo. ʻAʻohe mea i laka ʻia.
  • ʻAʻole pono ka moʻokāki. E komo inā makemake ʻoe e hoʻolike wale nō.
free: He manuahi ʻo My Quiet Bible, a pēlā mau nō. Inā he kōkua ia iā ʻoe, hiki iā ʻoe ke kōkua i ka hoʻāʻā mau ʻana i ke kukui. ʻAʻohe mea e kaukaʻi ana ma luna o ia.
installSub: A laila wehe ʻia ma ka pākū piha e like me nā polokalamu ʻē aʻe, mālama i kou wahi, a hana me ka pili ʻole i ka pūnaewele.
installSubComputer: A laila wehe ʻia i loko o kona puka aniani ponoʻī e like me nā polokalamu ʻē aʻe, mālama i kou wahi, a hana me ka pili ʻole i ka pūnaewele.
iosSteps:
• E wehe i ka Baibala ma Safari.
  • E kaomi i ke pihi papa koho ma ka pahu helu wahi, a laila ʻo Share {svg}. Ma nā iPhone kahiko, aia ʻo Share ma ka pahu ma lalo.
  • E kaomi iā View More, a laila ʻo Add to Home Screen {svg}.
  • E waiho iā Open as Web App i ʻā a e kaomi iā Add. ʻIke ʻia ke kukui ma kou Home Screen.
iosNote: E hana mai ka Baibala, ʻaʻole mai kēia ʻaoʻao, i wehe pololei ke kukui i kāu heluhelu ʻana. E hoʻohana iā Safari: ʻaʻole hiki mau i nā polokalamu kele ʻē aʻe ma iPhone a me iPad ke hoʻohui i kekahi polokalamu.
install: E hoʻokomo iā My Quiet Bible
orSafari: A i ʻole, me ka App Store ʻole, mai Safari:
androidNote: Hoʻokahi kaomi. ʻAʻohe mea e hele ma o ka hale kūʻai polokalamu.
androidInstalled: Ua hoʻokomo ʻia. E wehe i ke kukui me kāu mau polokalamu ʻē aʻe.
androidSteps:
• E wehe i ka Baibala ma Chrome, a i ʻole ka polokalamu kele āu e hoʻohana ai.
  • E wehe i ka papa koho o ka polokalamu kele, ʻo nā kiko ʻekolu {svg} ma luna ʻākau ka mea maʻamau.
  • E kaomi iā Install and create shortcut (ʻōlelo kekahi polokalamu kele Add to Home screen).
  • E koho iā Install, ʻaʻole ʻo Create shortcut. A laila e kaomi hou iā Install.
  • ʻIke ʻia ke kukui me kāu mau polokalamu ʻē aʻe.
computerNote: Wehe ʻia i loko o kona puka aniani ponoʻī, e like me nā polokalamu ʻē aʻe.
computerInstalled: Ua hoʻokomo ʻia. E wehe iā My Quiet Bible me kāu mau polokalamu ʻē aʻe.
computerSteps:
• E wehe i ka Baibala ma Chrome a i ʻole Edge.
  • E kaomi i ka hōʻailona hoʻokomo ma ka ʻaoʻao ʻākau o ka pahu helu wahi, he pākū me ka pua {svg}, a laila ʻo Install.
  • A i ʻole e mālama wale i ka ʻaoʻao. Hana like nō ia, a hoʻomanaʻo i kou wahi.
footNote: He waiwai lehulehu a he laikini hāmama paha nā kikokikona a pau. Aia ka laikini o kēlā me kēia unuhina ma ka polokalamu.
readP: i ka Baibala, ma nā unuhina he {{versions}}, manuahi.
prayP: me ka leo nui, me hoʻokahi pihi, no ka mea āu i heluhelu iho nei.
shareP: i kāu mau pule, ke makemake ʻoe, me kekahi poʻe pili loa iā ʻoe.
repeatP: i ka lā ʻapōpō. Mālama ia i kou wahi, a me kou helu o nā lā i ka lālani.
prayLong: Aia mau ke pihi 🙏 ma ka ʻaoʻao o ka pahu ʻimi. E kaomi a e haʻi leo nui i kāu pule. Mālama ʻia me nā paukū āu e heluhelu ana, no laila ma hope hiki iā ʻoe ke hoʻolohe hou a ʻike i ka mea āu i pule ai.
prayTicks:
• ʻAʻohe mea e kikokiko ai a ʻaʻohe mea e hoʻonohonoho ai.
  • Noho kāu mau pule ma kou kelepona, a i ʻole hoʻolike ʻia me ka laka ma kahi kī nāu wale nō.
  • Ma hope o ka ʻĀmene, e ʻike i nā ʻāina kahi i pule ai nā kānaka i kēia pule. ʻO ka ʻāina wale nō ka mea i helu ʻia.
circlesH: E pule pū, i loko o kahi pōʻai
circlesVerse: “No ka mea, ma kahi e ʻākoakoa ai nā mea ʻelua a ʻekolu paha ma koʻu inoa, malaila nō wau i waena o lākou.”
circlesLong: Ke makemake ʻoe, e hana i pōʻai liʻiliʻi no kou ʻohana a no kekahi mau hoaaloha paha. E kaʻana i kekahi pule, paukū a manaʻo kākau paha me hoʻokahi kaomi. Hoʻolohe lākou, pane mai me kekahi huaʻōlelo, a i ʻole pane mai me ka 🙏, a heluhelu kēlā me kēia i ka paukū ma kāna Baibala ponoʻī.
circlesAsk: E noi i kou pōʻai e pule nou, a e ʻike i ka nui o ka poʻe i pule.
circlesTicks:
• ʻAʻole koi ʻia. ʻAʻohe mea e haʻalele i kou kelepona ke kaomi ʻole ʻoe iā Kaʻana.
  • Loaʻa i kēlā me kēia pōʻai kona kī ponoʻī. ʻO kona mau lālā wale nō ka mea hiki ke wehe i nā mea i loko; ʻaʻole hiki iā mākou.
  • Pono nā pōʻai i ke komo manuahi, me kahi kī komo a i ʻole kahi helu i hoʻouna ʻia ma ka leka uila.
listenP: Kaomi i kekahi paukū, a laila Hoʻolohe. A i ʻole, kaomi iā Heluhelu pū ma ka pahu ʻimi, a hoʻomālamalama ʻia kēlā me kēia hua ʻōlelo i ka heluhelu ʻana. Heluhelu nā mea heluhelu maoli i ka BSB, ka King James a me ka Louis Segond. No ke kaʻa, ka lumi kuke, a i ʻole nā maka luhi.
